_note: Friendly editorial copy grounded in this group's personas.json. These are jokes, not attributed quotes. Pick-specific copy requires the matching team and direction.

matt_m.default: Matt needs {team} to make this pick look good. If it does not, expect a description featuring untapped potential, strong fundamentals, and a motivated seller.

picks.Penn State|O: Matt is selling the Penn State Over. A bad Saturday would be an excellent time for the group to ask whether the listing price has been reduced.
picks.Texas Tech|U: Matt took the Texas Tech Under. He sells real estate, so the group is entitled to ask for the comps before he declares this program overpriced.

hauck.default: Hauck hosts the game and keeps the receipts. If {team} cooperates, expect documentation. If it does not, hosting duties may suddenly become very absorbing.

picks.Kentucky|O: Hauck is an Ohio State man with a Kentucky Over. The group should ask whether this is a serious investment or just a tasting flight of SEC football.
picks.Ohio State|O: Hauck wants Ohio State wins. No tasting notes, no complicated explanation: this is the house pour.

bryan.default: Bryan runs a PE group and tends ferns. Now he needs growth from {team}. The group can ask whether this pick requires more patience, more capital, or a sunnier window.

picks.Michigan|U: Bryan is an Ohio State fan holding the Michigan Under. He can call it disciplined investing; the group can call it getting paid to do what he was already doing.
picks.South Florida|O: Bryan needs South Florida wins. A PE guy buying into the Bulls: the branding practically wrote the investment memo for him.

todd.default: Todd has decades of Browns practice at accepting outcomes. If {team} makes this difficult, the group can test whether that famously unbothered calm covers college football too.

picks.South Florida|U: Todd needs South Florida losses. The calmest man in the room has volunteered for a season of watching someone else's offense and hoping it stalls. Very Browns-adjacent relaxation.

zach.default: Zach's poker money has a habit of leaving with someone else. Now he needs {team} to prove that building a second game was a sound recovery strategy.

picks.LSU|O: Zach took the LSU Over. The group may ask how many lines of code were necessary to reach the same conclusion as his LSU shirt.

josh.default: Josh bought a VR treadmill to move through imaginary worlds. This weekend, {team} has to make actual progress. The group should clarify which kind is showing up in the standings.

picks.Stanford|O: Josh works at a vineyard and took the Stanford Over. If it needs time to develop, the group should ask whether this is a football pick or something he is aging in a barrel.

mark.default: Mark sells bread for a living. He needs {team} to make this pick rise. If it falls flat, the group has a regrettably large supply of bakery jokes ready.

picks.Indiana|O: Mark went to Indiana and took the Indiana Over. The diploma explains the loyalty; the scoreboard still has to explain the pick.
